title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
description: Yaiba’s journey to becoming a true samurai takes him from his home in the forest to a bustling city full of rivals, friends and ancient powers.

episodes.title: S1-E20The Ruse of Basho the Monkey

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Yaiba Kurogane is determined to become a true samurai, but things take an odd turn in the jungle.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yaiba has come up with a plan and is willing to do nearly anything to provoke Onimaru to a duel.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Onimaru now wants to fight Yaiba, but something's off, not least the horns sprouting from his head.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Yaiba has the Raijinken but it's the Thunder God that turns the tables on him. Then there's Onimaru.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Yaiba et al. head to Ganryu Island to learn about an arcane maken but end up at a shady hot spring.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Yaiba and crew are back on track but stop in Nagoya where there's more in store than great food.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Yaiba and his companions finally reach Ganryujima, where they encounter Mr. Spider — and a resurrected, but somewhat peeved, Sasaki Kojiro.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Musashi and Kojiro's duel must proceed as recorded so Yaiba can return to his original time, but Yaiba's careless comment threatens to change history.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Needing to develop a new sword technique that can counter Onimaru, Yaiba undergoes further grueling training with Musashi — and a scheming Kojiro.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Yaiba and his companions storm Onimaru Castle, but they fall through a trap into the depths of the stronghold and face Onimaru's new henchmen.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: While Yaiba rides high, Onimaru tempts the young hero. And in pure Yaiba fashion, eyebrows rise.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A showdown's heating up between Yaiba and Onimaru, but the neighborhood rumor mill is even hotter.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Yaiba and team learn of an orb that promises gravity-defying powers. But an undead assassin awaits...

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Lake Biwa's orb surprises, but it's Shikoku's Mt. Tsurugi that hides a shadowy and dangerous threat.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Team Yaiba may have secured the Gold Orb on Shikoku, but it's on to Kyushu, and on Yaiba's back.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Troupe Yaiba traipses to Nara for a pivotal tip-off, but it's an odd traveling warrior who shows up.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Yaiba battles Goemon using the Orb of Giants only to lose two of the spheres to the villain's guile.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Jubei's giving Yaiba and team a fighting chance, but that's before they meet the ninja army

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Team Yaiba unmasks the true nature of the mysterious orb seized from Goemon, and it’s unlike anything the travelers have encountered before. This time, aspirations are a liability. Is this new realm a dream come true? Or is it a nightmare about to unfurl?

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The team is eager to grab the illusive final prize, but a decrepit temple and old man stand defiant.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: An off-the-wall sphere guides Yaiba to Mt. Fuji to find the elusive and perilous Dragon God Orb.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Yaiba arrives at the crater of Mt. Fuji only to be faced with a dilemma he could've never imagined.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: At the trial to end all trials, the Dragon God desires decisiveness through an impossible choice.

episodes_data.title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: With the ultimate orb and new maken, Yaiba is victorious. But a new battle unfolds over the Pacific.
